This complete original source is not an installed-application acceptance record. Use its maintained source_tools/install_cumulative_application.py with --source set to this root and --output set to an independent new application directory. Its default --scientific-source is the retained source root; retain any original received canonical scientific source if the owner's existing install requires that edition.

Keep any active native child and its original installed source directory unchanged until the normal process boundary. Continue the sole SOL61 5156 Workspace and original command; this source delivery does not authorize another model worker or another project.

The maintained installer composes registered components and shared Operator hooks, restores original inputs, records actual installed postimages in CUMULATIVE_INSTALLATION.json, and optionally creates an archive through --archive outside the source and application directories.

Retain AGENTS.md, CLAUDE.md, GEMINI.md, rendered-product-inspection-policy.*, .claude/rules/rendered-product-inspection.md and .github/copilot-instructions.md. Before presenting a populated outgoing product as ready, the producing worker opens and visually inspects actual screens at screenshare and narrow widths, operates controls/downloads/save-reopen, and repairs visible defects.

Reuse the existing simulated-headwaters Workspace/output and its retained recipe, profile, grid and run IDs. Native model execution is owned by SOL61; ASTRA receives the same completed case. The cutoff remains 2026-10-13T14:00:00Z.
